faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does my phone number stay private?
faq.a1: When a passerby scans the QR code on your windshield, they are taken to a secure webpage. Messages sent are relayed through our automated server to your chosen channel. The scanner never sees your phone number, email, or name.
faq.q2: Do I need to activate or scan anything when the sticker arrives?
faq.a2: No! We assign your pre-printed sticker to your vehicle upon signup. When it arrives in your mailbox, it is already 100% active and ready to stick on your windshield.
faq.q3: How fast is shipping within the Netherlands?
faq.a3: We dispatch all stickers within 24 hours via PostNL letterbox parcel (Brievenbuspakje). You receive a 3S Track & Trace barcode. Since it fits in your mailbox, you do not need to be home.
faq.q4: Can I switch between WhatsApp, SMS, and email later?
faq.a4: Yes, instantly and free of charge via your Dashboard. You choose 1 active primary communication channel at any time.
faq.q5: Does the sticker renew automatically or charge my card?
faq.a5: No! Ping Me is completely free of automatic commitments. You choose a 1, 2, or 3-year pass with a single upfront payment. When your validity period ends, we send you a reminder giving you the freedom to renew your sticker only if you wish.
